baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural callers in نَادَوْا shift to the singular insider صَاحِبَهُمْ, who alone performs تَعَاطَىٰ and عَقَرَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A collective call activates an in-group companion, who boldly takes up the task and produces bodily disablement. Commission and execution are grammatically divided, so the singular deed remains socially distributed.

activation_trace.role: The raised call is the collective's operative first move, activating another agent.
Companionship and close association mark the executor as an insider bound to the callers.
Bold undertaking converts the summons into an audaciously assumed task.
Cutting a beast's legs supplies the concrete disabling endpoint.

changed_reading.before: A man is called and then attacks.
changed_reading.after: The attack is collective-by-proxy: group speech commissions it, insider affiliation authorizes it, and one agent executes it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated فَ links نَادَوْا, تَعَاطَىٰ, and عَقَرَ in a compressed sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Call, bodily reaching or taking, and disabling follow as one rapid action circuit. The summons is not background dialogue but the first efficient cause in the chain.

activation_trace.role: The audible summons initiates the action circuit.
Taking or reaching by hand gives the middle verb bodily and instrumental force.
Arrested movement makes stoppage, not merely injury, the sequence's result.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports three neighboring actions.
changed_reading.after: The verse presents a nearly interval-free causal chain in which speech recruits a hand and the hand stops movement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive bond in صَاحِبَهُمْ is placed between the collective call and the wound.
baseline_models.mechanism: The semantic field of companionship can preserve, accompany, and serve, but here that trusted proximity becomes the channel through which harm is delivered. The companion relation is functionally inverted.

activation_trace.role: Preservation through accompaniment supplies the positive relational expectation that the event reverses.
Service and supplying what one's people want turn affiliation into practical compliance.
Wounding supplies the harmful result carried through the companion relation.

changed_reading.before: Their companion merely identifies which man acted.
changed_reading.after: His being theirs explains the deed's social route: trusted proximity and service are converted into a capacity to wound.

context_deltas.mechanism: The group rejects following one singular human from among them and marks him liar and insolent, yet it immediately concentrates its own will in one in-group companion. The contrast revises the proxy baseline: singular agency is acceptable when possessed by the group and objectionable when it makes an independent claim on them.

activation_trace.role: Singularity and separation sharpen the rejected status of the one proposed leader.
Following supplies the allegiance the speakers refuse to give that one man.
The interval among the group marks selection from within a shared social field.
Attributing falsehood supplies the group's delegitimating label for the independent claimant.
Sharp insolence supplies the second label used to reject his standing.
The group's assembly and consultation field turns its call into corporate selection.
Their companion embodies a singular agent whose authority derives from belonging to them.

structural_cues: 54:24-25 stages a plural dispute over following one man from among the group; 54:29 moves from plural callers to one possessed companion.
The rejected man is named through accusatory predicates, while the chosen agent is named relationally as theirs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rejected one-man following, in-group selection, hostile labels, and a summoned companion; I infer that controllability rather than number distinguishes the two agents. A live alternative is that the companion contrast is narrative proximity without a claim about legitimacy.

changed_reading.before: The group delegates an attack to an insider.
changed_reading.after: The delegation exposes a politics of agency: they refuse one independent human but manufacture an acceptable one-man authority by making him their proxy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Future knowing, an explicit test, watchful waiting, and endurance frame the focus action as the observable result of an experiment. The rapid undertaking and disabling deed disclose the collective through the agent it activates.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower sets an epistemic horizon for the coming event.
Testing a person or material makes subsequent conduct diagnostic rather than incidental.
Watching and waiting establish the observer posture under which the result will appear.
Holding oneself from agitation supplies the temporal restraint surrounding observation.
Audacious undertaking is the conduct exposed by the test.
The disabling act gives the test a concrete and irreversible result.

structural_cues: 54:26 forecasts knowing, 54:27 names a test and commands watching and endurance, and 54:29 supplies the compact observed act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the forecast, test, observer posture, and deed; I infer that the deed is what the test reveals about the group through its proxy. The alternative is that the testing frame applies more broadly and the focus is only one episode within it.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a sudden offense.
changed_reading.after: The focus is also a diagnostic disclosure: the watched test makes collective character visible through the agent selected to act.

context_deltas.mechanism: A she-camel participates in a water regime divided among parties, with each drinking share attended. Against that regulated circulation, تَعَاطَىٰ shifts from neutral taking or exchange toward overreaching, and عَقَرَ removes one living claimant. The deed becomes coercive intervention in a commons, not only bodily violence.

activation_trace.role: The she-camel image resolves the otherwise unspoken target of the focus action.
Literal water supplies the scarce circulating resource.
Separating allotted shares supplies the governing distribution.
The relation between parties makes the division a shared arrangement rather than private possession.
A water share gives each party a defined access claim.
Attendance and nearness make each access period publicly observable.
Giving and taking preserve the background possibility of reciprocal allocation.
Overreaching converts regulated exchange into unauthorized seizure of the situation.
Disabling the beast removes a claimant by attacking its capacity to move.

structural_cues: The water division of 54:28 immediately precedes the summons and disabling act of 54:29.
The focus omits the object of عَقَرَ, while 54:27 supplies the she-camel as the salient living participant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the she-camel, divided water, attended shares, taking, and disablement; I infer that removing one participant coercively captures or cancels its place in the schedule. A live alternative is hostility to the sign without resource control as the actor's motive.

changed_reading.before: The proxy boldly attacks the she-camel.
changed_reading.after: The proxy converts an attended allocation system into exclusion by physically eliminating one participant's access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence repeatedly turns living bodies into severed or broken matter: people are uprooted like palm trunks, the focus agent disables a beast by its legs, and one terrifying cry leaves the collective like broken enclosure debris. The focus becomes the hinge where inflicted severance returns upon the inflicting group in another material form.

activation_trace.role: Pulling something from its fixed place introduces the sequence's first severance dynamic.
The palm tree supplies the first conversion of human bodies into damaged plant matter.
Uprooting from the origin completes the earlier image of bodily removal.
Cutting the beast's legs places an inflicted severance at the center of the pattern.
The terrifying cry supplies the force that returns disablement upon the collective.
Dry broken vegetation converts the resulting collective into fragmented material.
The enclosure that gathers and confines supplies the ruined material's social-space frame.

structural_cues: A body-to-uprooted-palm comparison precedes the Thamud scene, while a body-to-broken-enclosure-material comparison follows the focus.
The focus itself places leg-cutting between those two collective materializations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uprooting, leg-cutting, a cry, and broken enclosure matter; I infer a returned direction from violence inflicted to violence undergone. The alternative is compositional recurrence across episodes without a specific reversal claim.

changed_reading.before: The hamstringing is one violent event within the narrative.
changed_reading.after: The hamstringing is a material hinge in a reversal pattern: those who commission bodily severance are themselves rendered broken matter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The passage rejects one human, mobilizes one companion from a plural group, and answers with one terrifying cry. Repeated concentration into a singleton makes the focus's plural-to-singular grammar part of a larger rebound: collective will is compressed into one executor, then collective consequence into one event.

activation_trace.role: Numerical oneness marks the singular human whom the group refuses to follow.
The plural call concentrates the group's initiative in a summoned agent.
The singular companion becomes the collective's embodied representative.
A terrifying cry supplies the answering event that overtakes the group.
Numerical oneness compresses the entire consequence into a single cry.

structural_cues: 54:24 says one human, 54:29 changes from plural callers to a singular companion, and 54:31 says one cry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three group-singleton transitions; I infer a designed rebound from concentrated agency to concentrated consequence. The alternative is that each singular merely serves its local syntax without forming a cross-ayah mechanism.

changed_reading.before: One companion happens to carry out a group request.
changed_reading.after: His singularity is structurally charged: the group concentrates itself in one actor before one event concentrates the consequence upon them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the branch-distant raised عَقِيرَة voice within عَقَرَ beside its ordinary disabling force. It remains anchored in the focus's opening call, the cited عقر branch, and the following terrifying cry; downstream prose should present it only as an acoustic halo, not as a replacement translation of عَقَرَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus opens with نَادَوْا and closes with عَقَرَ, whose inventory retains a raised-voice branch.

activation_trace.role: A raised call gives the focus an explicit vocal opening.
The raised عَقِيرَة voice lets the closing root retain a secondary vocal resonance.
The following loud voice extends the call-action sequence into an answering sound.

changed_reading.before: The verse moves from a call to a purely physical injury.
changed_reading.after: Without changing the physical sense, the final root carries a faint vocal resonance that helps the human call return as the following cry.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because نَادَوْا ordinarily supplies a call, while the activated ندو branch concerns moving livestock between water and nearby pasture. It remains worth carrying because the immediately preceding ayah explicitly organizes water shares and attendance; downstream prose should call it a pastoral scene-resonance, never a direct translation of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نَادَوْا stands at the transition from an attended drinking schedule to action against the she-camel.

activation_trace.role: Literal water establishes the material center of the preceding arrangement.
The allotted drink supplies a scheduled livestock-access setting.
Presence at and return to water reinforce a recurring access cycle.
Moving livestock between water and nearby pasture gives the call a contained pastoral resonance.
Leg-cutting violently terminates the animal's movement through that cycle.

changed_reading.before: The call is solely a speech act before the attack.
changed_reading.after: As a qualified resonance, the call also sits inside livestock coordination around water and pasture, which the disabling act abruptly terminates.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it extends leg-cutting through distant عقر branches of barrenness and a final thing with no successor. The reading remains anchored in the focus verb and the packet's she-camel, but downstream prose should frame it as a secondary image of terminated futurity, not assert reproductive intent or replace the concrete hamstringing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَقَرَ names the culminating injury to the she-camel and carries branches of bodily and generative interruption.

activation_trace.role: The she-camel supplies the living animal to which the focus's distant generative branches can attach.
Barrenness extends disablement from locomotion toward interruption of generation.
A last thing with nothing following supplies the image of a future forcibly closed.

changed_reading.before: The act stops one animal's present movement.
changed_reading.after: As a contained lexical halo, the act also figures the production of no-further-going: bodily disablement radiates into terminated continuation.

strongest_changes: Plural speech and singular execution make the deed collective-by-proxy rather than privately individual.
The contrast between refusing one independent human and activating one owned companion turns the focus into a dispute over controllable agency.
The explicit test, watching, and future knowing make the act a diagnostic disclosure of the group through its proxy.
The divided, attended water shares turn the injury into coercive cancellation of a participant's place in a regulated commons.
Uprooted trunks before and broken enclosure matter after make the focus a hinge in returned severance.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's plural-call and singular-action grammar connected contested authority, a watched allocation test, and material and acoustic reversals. Branch-distant water-pasture, raised-voice, and barrenness images remained live only as contained resonances.
remaining_uncertainties: The contrast between independent leader and controlled proxy may be structurally intended or may arise from close narrative sequencing.
The water arrangement clearly frames the deed, but resource capture as motive is reader-supplied rather than explicit.
The singleton, material, and acoustic rebounds may be deliberate mechanisms or compositional parallels without direct causal force.
The three outliers depend on distant branch images and should not be promoted into primary lexical translations.
